question: Should Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should the current inline composer, send-shortcut setting, and paste-attachment direction remain the intended solution?
rationale: The request is viable and aligned with web-frontend ergonomics, but it adds a second composer mode with product-owned draft, keyboard, attachment, and send semantics rather than fixing a defined bug.

options.title: Keep Open For UX Direction
options.body: Leave this issue open and out of repair automation until a Control UI owner chooses whether the expanded modal should exist.

options.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
options.body: Approve a focused Control UI implementation of the modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, and keyboard/focus tests.

options.title: Prefer Existing Inline Path
options.body: Treat inline autosizing, modifier-send, and large-paste attachment work as the intended long-prompt path and close or narrow this request.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For UX Direction
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and out of repair automation until a Control UI owner chooses whether the expanded modal should exist.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest adjacent send-shortcut ownership and prior review context on this exact issue.
